text:
**112 years.** That is how long the Sennet Lighthouse stayed in continuous operation, from 1875 until its light was extinguished for the last time on 14 October 1987.

Harbourmaster Idris Calloway of the Sennet Point Port Authority signed the final order and recorded the shutdown. The report rests on Port Authority Decommissioning Notice No. 87-31, issued ahead of the automated Corran Buoy beacon taking over the station's navigation duties.

The year of decommissioning is therefore 1987.

**What it means for the sector:** The handover shows port operators moving navigation duties from staffed stations to automated aids. Fixed-site upkeep is replaced by a single buoy-based system. Operators with comparable legacy stations will likely weigh the same trade-off between heritage value and running costs.
